verdict.justification: Both deliverables accurately extract the 33 wells across the 8 requested Illinois EPA water systems and properly apply the screening criteria to identify the 7 viable wells. However, Deliverable B is superior because it reads and synthesizes the full IEPA SWAP factsheets rather than just scraping the well tables. For example, Deliverable B notes critical discrepancies between the factsheet narrative and the well table, pointing out that "Farmer City lists Well 2 as a supply well, but the table shows it ABANDONED" and that "Well 7 (WL47646) - 180 ft... is active in the IEPA well table but not named in the system narrative, so its current use needs to be confirmed." Deliverable B also provides valuable context from the narratives on system capacity (e.g., Farmer City "averages 257,000 gal/day" and three excluded systems "report 100% purchased water") and includes relevant DOE hydrogen water consumption benchmarks ("2.4-8 gal per kg H2"). Furthermore, Deliverable B enhances the second tab of the Excel workbook by ranking the 7 potential wells and adding a "PM Comment" column explaining the priority of each option, whereas Deliverable A leaves the second tab unranked and unannotated.

decisive_issues.issue: Did not cross-reference the well table against the factsheet narrative, missing important operational discrepancies on top-recommended Well 7 and abandoned Well 2.
